I cannot compute a definitive embedded-emissions figure. The scenario gives a quantity (500 t) and a country (China), but not a good CN code, and the ruleset requires the CN code to select the default SEE value.

**Missing input:**
- **(a) Good CN code.** The scenario says only "a steel product," which does not match any CN code in the factor table.

For China, the table contains four candidate codes, and each has a different default SEE:

| CN code | Good | Default SEE (tCO2e/t) |
|---|---|---|
| 7201 | Pig iron and spiegeleisen, in pigs, blocks or other primary forms | 1.66 |
| 7206 10 00 | Ingots, of iron and non-alloy steel (excl. remelted scrap ingots) | 1.74 |
| 7207 11 90 | Semi-finished products of iron or non-alloy steel | 3.314 |
| 7214 20 00 | Bars and rods, of iron or non-alloy steel, with indentations | 3.169 |

Once you confirm the CN code, the calculation is: embedded emissions (tCO2e) = SEE × 500 t, rounded half-up to 2 decimal places.
